name: Ap dung Ma Giam Gia (Coupon)
description:
HW06 - 23127195 - API-2 (Pool B, FR-09).

Phu: bang quyet dinh 5 dieu kien C1-C5 cua FR-09, phan tich gia tri bien tren min_order_amount, oracle so hoc cho cong thuc giam gia (percent / fixed), state transition tren so luot su dung theo tung nguoi dung, security SEC-02/SEC-05, va schema validation.

Du lieu coupon seed (backend/database.js):
  SAVE10  percent 10   min 300000  het han 2099-12-31  max 1 luot/nguoi  (id=1)
  BIGBUY  fixed   50000 min 500000  het han 2099-12-31  max 1 luot/nguoi  (id=2)
  VIP100  fixed  100000 min 300000  het han 2099-12-31  max 2 luot/nguoi  (id=3)
  EXPIRED percent 20   min 100000  het han 2020-01-01  max 1 luot/nguoi  (id=4)

Sinh tu testcases/api2_fr09_testcases.json bang postman/scripts/build_collections.py.
